document.heading: PUEBLO DE SAN ILDEFONSO COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. SI-R26-009
Amendment Extending the Act Approving Tax Subsidy to San Ildefonso Services, LLC
document.preamble: At a duly called meeting of the Council of San Ildefonso Pueblo on the 25th day of June, 2026, the following resolution was adopted:

recital.text: the Council established and chartered San Ildefonso Services, LLC ("SIS, LLC") under tribal law as a single-member limited liability company wholly owned by the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Pueblo"); and,
SIS, LLC owns and operates two businesses within Pueblo lands commonly referred to as the Totavi and White Rock Convenience Stores and Gas Stations ("C-Stores"); and,

the Council transferred ownership and operation of the C-Stores to SIS, LLC, effective July 1, 2017, pursuant to the, "Act to Transfer Ownership and Operation of C-Stores to San Ildefonso Services, LLC", dated June 21, 2017; and,
since the acquisition of the C-Stores, SIS, LLC has endeavored to improve the operations and profitability of the C-Stores; and,

on June 6, 2018, the Council formally approved a subsidy for the benefit of SIS, LLC in the amount of $0.06 for every gallon of gasoline sold in the C-Stores ("Subsidy") pursuant to Tribal Council Resolution No. SI-R18-011, titled "Act Approving Tax Subsidy to San Ildefonso Services, LLC" ("Subsidy Act"); and,
the Subsidy Act was subsequently extended and restated, and at a Council Meeting August 26, 2021 was adopted effective June 1, 2021 and expiring May 31, 2026; and,
SIS, LLC requests and recommends the Subsidy Act be amended to extend the term for another 5-year period, effective June 1, 2026, and expiring on May 31, 2031, for operational costs; and,

the Council has determined that it is in the Pueblo's best interests to support SIS, LLC and its operation of the C-Stores by extending the Subsidy in the amount of $0.06 for every gallon of gasoline sold in the C-Stores for another 5-year period beginning on June 1, 2026 and expiring on May 31, 2031; and,
the Subsidy could be paid by the Pueblo from tax revenues generated by the Pueblo's $0.17 per gallon fuel tax or from other funds the Council sees fit.

para.text: Enacts the attached resolution entitled the "Amendment Extending the Act Approving Tax Subsidy to San Ildefonso Services, LLC."
Authorizes and directs the Governor, or his designee to take such actions as deemed necessary to carry out the intent of this resolution.

procedural-data.text: The foregoing resolution was duly voted upon by the Council on June 25, 2026, at a meeting with a vote of 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 2 abstaining and 2 absent (Governor presiding and not voting) pursuant to the authority vested in the Council by the Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso.

codify:replace.heading: Amendment Extending the Act Approving Tax Subsidy to San Ildefonso Services, LLC

attachment.heading: AMENDMENT EXTENDING THE ACT APPROVING TAX SUBSIDY TO SAN ILDEFONSO SERVICES, LLC

section.heading: Short Title
section.text: This enactment shall be known as "AMENDMENT EXTENDING THE ACT APPROVING TAX SUBSIDY TO SAN ILDEFONSO SERVICES, LLC" ("Act").

para.text: "Council" means the Pueblo de San Ildefonso Council.
"Pueblo" means the Pueblo de San Ildefonso.

section.heading: Purpose
section.text: The Purpose of this Act is to amend and extend the Subsidy Act for another 5 years, beginning June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2031.

para.text: San Ildefonso Services, LLC ("SIS, LLC") was chartered by the Pueblo under tribal law as a single-member limited liability company wholly owned by the Pueblo.
SIS, LLC owns and operates two businesses within Pueblo lands commonly referred to as the Totavi and White Rock Convenience Stores and Gas Stations ("C-Stores").

The Council transferred ownership and operation of the C-Stores to SIS, LLC, effective July 1, 2017, pursuant to the, "Act to Transfer Ownership and Operation of C-Stores to San Ildefonso Services, LLC", dated June 21, 2017.
Since the acquisition of the C-Stores, SIS, LLC has endeavored to improve the operations and profitability of the C-Stores.

On June 6, 2018, the Council formally approved a subsidy for the benefit of SIS, LLC in the amount of $0.06 for every gallon of gasoline sold in the C-Stores ("Subsidy") pursuant to Tribal Council Resolution No. SI-R18-011, titled "Act Approving Tax Subsidy to San Ildefonso Services, LLC" ("Subsidy Act").
The Subsidy Act was subsequently extended and restated, and at a Council Meeting on August 26, 2021 was adopted effective June 1, 2021 and expiring May 31, 2026; and
SIS, LLC requests and recommends the Subsidy Act be amended to extend the term for another 5-year period effective June 1, 2026, and expiring on May 31, 2031, for operational costs.

The Council has determined that it is in the Pueblo's best interests to support SIS, LLC and its operation of the C-Stores by extending the Subsidy in the amount of $0.06 for every gallon of gasoline sold in the C-Stores for another 5-year period beginning on June 1, 2026 and expiring on May 31, 2031.
The Subsidy could be paid by the Pueblo from tax revenues generated by the Pueblo's $0.17 per gallon fuel tax, or other funds as the Council sees fit.
The Council hereby amends and extends the Subsidy to SIS LLC in the amount of $0.06 for every gallon of gasoline sold by the C-Stores.
The Subsidy shall be paid by the Pueblo from revenues generated by the Pueblo's $0.17 per gallon fuel tax, or other funds as the Council sees fit.
The Subsidy shall be used by SIS to reduce costs of gasoline in order to make upgrades to the fuel pumps and the C-Stores, and the Subsidy shall not be used for any other purpose.
The Subsidy shall be effective as of June 1, 2026, and shall expire on May 31, 2031.
SIS, LLC shall provide monthly financial statements and fuel reports, and such other information and documents to the Governor and Council to support the expenditure and continuation of the Subsidy.
The Council authorizes the Governor to execute any documents that may be necessary to support the Subsidy.
The Governor is authorized to take such actions as deemed necessary to carry out the intent this Act.
